paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.77% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+0.20%) and Hang Seng weakest (-2.36%). Brent crude changed +2.06% to 111.06. Gold changed -2.22% to 4,057.8. Bitcoin changed +0.23% to 81,256.7422. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.993%, a relative move of -2.42%. Among the firms tracked, Vale (-9.06%) and HSBC (-7.26%) moved the most.
